title: Meta掌上AI设备：云端智能体全天候运行，丢了会自己找你？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: They are launching a new device now device where you can interface with their muse agent using this device and everything still runs on the cloud. Nothing is on the device.
segments.zh: 他们现在推出了一款新设备，你可以通过它和Muse智能体交互，一切仍在云端运行，设备本身不存储任何东西。

segments.en: But it's an easier way for you to interact using voice and instead of you know opening your app on the smartphone.
segments.zh: 但用语音交互更方便，不用再打开手机上的应用。

segments.en: This device is listening to you all the time and you're pretty much you know talking to it as if it's your agent.
segments.zh: 这个设备一直在听你说话，你基本上就像在和自己的智能体对话。

segments.en: Do I put it on my keychain? Do I put it on my Bloomberg Lannier? What do I do with this thing?
segments.zh: 我是把它挂在钥匙链上？还是别在彭博工牌上？这东西到底怎么用？

segments.en: He's going to lose this thing in about five minutes.
segments.zh: 他大概五分钟就会把这东西弄丢。

segments.en: I'm still looking for your butt down here in this radio studio.
segments.zh: 我还在这个电台演播室里找你的屁股呢。

segments.en: But the good thing is the device can figure out if it's lost and you know send you some sort of a message that hey Paul you may have left the device.
segments.zh: 但好处是，设备能判断自己是否丢失，然后给你发消息说：嘿，保罗，你可能把设备落下了。

segments.en: Wait, is this like a million engineering Greece and he's talking about like losing a device? I mean, is this the 2026 version of the Tamangachi?
segments.zh: 等等，这算是什么百万级工程奇迹，他却在聊弄丢设备？这是2026版的电子宠物吗？

segments.en: Well, that's what I think some people are comparing it to but at the end of the day they're saying this is a persistent agent that is running 24-7.
segments.zh: 我觉得有人是这么比的，但说到底，他们说这是一个全天候运行的持久智能体。

segments.en: Whether you initiate the agent through the app on your smartphone or through this device, it's going to work behind the scenes 24-7.
segments.zh: 无论你是通过手机应用还是这个设备启动智能体，它都会全天候在后台运行。

segments.en: You don't have to constantly prompt it or you know engage with it.
segments.zh: 你不需要不断提示它或与它互动。
